hook.name: FTMonsterArcadeV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the FTMonster Arcade project that routes fees from every ETH-in swap to a jackpot, penalty draw pool, LP club, and API wallet. It implements a "fuse" surcharge on token-to-ETH sells that spike price above a moving window high, tracks LP positions for rewards, and gates all activity behind a launcher-controlled `launched` boolean.
